scenarios.scenario: Keep tabs-only ribbon when switching between a part and Home

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon tab is selected
the ribbon display policy is "Minimize to Tabs"
the ribbon is minimized to tabs
the Home workspace is available as a document tab
the user selects the Home document tab
the Home workspace is displayed
the ribbon remains minimized to tabs
the Tools ribbon tab is visible
the user selects the open part document tab
the part workspace and its model browser are displayed
the ribbon remains minimized to tabs
the Tools ribbon tab remains selected

scenarios.scenario: Dismiss temporary Home commands when activating an open part

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is open in the MCAD Software
the Home workspace is active
the ribbon is minimized to tabs
the Tools ribbon tab is visible
the user clicks the Tools ribbon tab
the Home-context Tools commands appear temporarily
Document Settings is unavailable
the user selects the open part document tab
the part workspace and model browser appear
the temporary Home-context commands are closed
the part ribbon remains minimized to tabs
the Tools ribbon tab is selected

scenarios.scenario: Dismiss temporary part commands when activating Home

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon is minimized to tabs
the Tools ribbon tab is selected
the Home workspace is available as a document tab
the user clicks the Tools ribbon tab
the part-context Tools commands appear temporarily
Document Settings is available
the user selects the Home document tab
the Home workspace is displayed
the temporary part-context commands are closed
the Home ribbon remains minimized to tabs
the user selects the open part document tab
the part workspace and model browser appear
the part ribbon remains minimized to tabs
the Tools ribbon tab is selected

scenarios.scenario: Minimize while a panel context menu is open

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the display control is configured to toggle between the full ribbon and compact group buttons
the user right-clicks the Modify panel title
the panel context menu opens
the user clicks the ribbon display control
the context menu closes
the 3D Model ribbon shows compact group buttons
the part remains visible
the user clicks the ribbon display control again
the full 3D Model ribbon returns
the context menu remains closed

scenarios.scenario: Toggle full and tabs-only display by double-clicking the active tab

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the user double-clicks the active Tools tab
the ribbon shows its tabs without permanent command groups
the user double-clicks the active Tools tab again
the full Tools command groups are visible again
the part remains active

scenarios.scenario: Inspect ribbon appearance choices without changing the display mode

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited in the MCAD Software
a part has an active editable sketch in the MCAD Software
ribbon appearance is set to Normal
the user opens Ribbon Appearance from the Create panel title context menu
Normal is checked
Text Off, Small, Compact, Large and Reset Ribbon are listed
the user presses Escape twice
the Ribbon Appearance submenu remains open
the user clicks in the viewport outside the menu
the panel context menu closes
the ribbon remains in Normal appearance
the sketch remains active and unchanged

scenarios.scenario: Dismiss the ribbon appearance submenu with Escape

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open with the full 3D Model ribbon displayed in the MCAD Software
the Modify panel context menu is open with Ribbon Appearance expanded
Normal is the checked ribbon appearance
the user presses Escape twice
the Ribbon Appearance submenu and panel context menu close
the full ribbon remains displayed in Normal appearance
the part remains active

scenarios.scenario: Hide command labels and restore the normal ribbon appearance

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited in the MCAD Software
a part has an active editable sketch in the MCAD Software
Ribbon Appearance is set to Normal
the user opens Ribbon Appearance from the Create panel title context menu
the user selects Text Off
command labels are hidden while command icons and panel titles remain visible
the active sketch remains unchanged
the user opens Ribbon Appearance again
the user selects Normal
command labels return to the ribbon
the active sketch remains unchanged
